name: GET /api/leadflow/sequences/{key}/performance - Per-step rates and why enrolments stopped
description: Reports, per step of one cadence, how many executed, how many actually dispatched and how many were skipped, plus a tally of the reasons enrolments stopped. dispatch_rate is NULL rather than 0 when a step has never executed, and that distinction is the point: 0% reads as a step that always fails, while null says nobody has reached it yet - opposite conclusions about whether to change the cadence. The stop reasons are grouped on the prefix before the colon, so 'sms_stop' and 'unsubscribe' aggregate as themselves rather than fragmenting across the free-text detail appended to each. QA: depends on register and login for the bearer token; a cadence with no enrolments answers 200 with empty arrays, which is a real answer rather than a 404.

testCases.name: The active cadence reports its per-step rates
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
